messages.content: "你能幫我幾件事嗎？首先，我想要計算一個底為12公尺、高為15公尺的三角形的面積。我希望結果以平方公尺為單位。其次，我對「電話」的發明者和發明年份很感興趣。你能幫我找到嗎？最後，我正在計劃一次公路旅行，需要從「紐約市」到「洛杉磯」的路線指引。我希望避開「收費站」和「高速公路」。你能為我提供最佳路線嗎？"

function.name: map_service_get_directions
function.description: Retrieve directions from a starting location to an ending location, including options for route preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. Default is none if not specified.

function.name: geometry_area_triangle
function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

base.description: The length of the base of the triangle.

height.description: The height of the triangle from the base.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the area. Defaults to square meters.

function.name: science_history_get_invention
function.description: Retrieve the inventor and year of invention based on the invention's name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

want_year.description: Return the year of invention if set to true.

message.reasoning:
The user wants three tasks:

1) Compute area of triangle with base=12 m, height=15 m; result in sq.m.

2) Find inventor and year of invention for "telephone".

3) Get driving directions from New York City to Los Angeles avoiding tolls and highways (i.e., no toll roads or highways). They want best route.

We have two relevant tool calls: geometry_area_triangle and science_history_get_invention. For directions we need map_service_get_directions but note they said "Avoid toll stations and highways". In our tool signature, avoid can include "tolls", "highways", "ferries". So we should pass avoid=["tolls","highways"]? But the type says avoid?: "tolls"|"highways"|["ferries"]. Actually it's union types incorrectly typed. It expects either one value or array? Let's interpret as optional list of strings. We'll provide both.

Thus call map_service_get_directions start="New York City" end="Los Angeles" avoid=["tolls","highways"]

Also compute area via geometry_area_triangle(base=12,height=15)

And get telephone info via science_history_get_invention(invention_name="Telephone", want_year=true).

We'll produce separate responses after each tool invocation. Use multiple messages accordingly.
